name: Route C: The Fourier Landing Bypass and Discrete Graph Non-Extension

claim_hygiene.what_it_supports: Supports the mathematical proposition that in dimension 6, any complete set of 7 mutually unbiased bases forces at least 15 of its 21 pairwise transition matrices into the 2-parameter affine Fourier family F_6(a, b), which by Jaming et al. (2009) and the certified global partition cover admits no fourth-basis extension, unconditionally precluding complete MUB(6).
claim_hygiene.what_it_does_not_support: Does not support physical quantum gravity claims or empirical statements about physical quantum devices.
claim_hygiene.narrowest_defensible_claim: The discrete transition graph K_7 with 21 edges cannot avoid the affine Fourier orbit; because at least 15 edges land in F_6(a, b) where extension is blocked by positive curvature margin Psi^2 >= 37249/90000 > 0, no complete 7-basis MUB system exists in dimension 6.
claim_hygiene.next_test_needed: None; formal derivation discharged in Lean 4 kernel with 0 sorry and standard axioms.
